# Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration

Uses workflows extracted from demonstrations to constrain reinforcement-learning exploration for interactive web tasks.

- Catalog URL: https://awesomecua.github.io/resources/arxiv-1802-08802/
- Original source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1802.08802
- Kind: paper
- Review: curated

- Environments: web
- Topics: reinforcement-learning, workflow

# Screen Recognition: Creating Accessibility Metadata for Mobile Applications from Pixels

# Grounding Open-Domain Instructions to Automate Web Support Tasks

Introduces RUSS, which translates support instructions into a domain-specific language and grounds them in actionable web elements.

# ScreenQA: Large-Scale Question-Answer Pairs over Mobile App Screenshots

Introduces screenshot question answering over mobile interfaces, linking answers to screen content and bounding boxes.

- Review: curated

# MUG: Interactive Multimodal Grounding on User Interfaces

Studies iterative UI grounding in which users refine or correct an agent's interpretation over multiple conversational turns.

# ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding

Moves controlled target icons across high-resolution interfaces to diagnose spatial blind zones in grounding models and study targeted augmentation.

- Review: curated
- Scope: core
- Environments: desktop
- Topics: recording, workflow, video
- Evidence checked: 2026-10-16T10:47:49Z
- ID: url:243ab00712ba19cc2089

## Limitations

The card documents post hoc selection of the 286-task OSWorld subset based on model outcomes, uncalibrated coordinate annotations, and missing task-success acceptance records. It provides no train/test split or complete evaluator and does not claim complete anonymization. Review these limits before training or evaluation; the collection is an offline demonstration asset.

# ScreenDrag

GUI dragging data with screen observations, prior state, and continuous pointer actions, provided as trajectory files and Parquet representations.

- Catalog URL: https://awesomecua.github.io/resources/url-fe43af1801032be708cc/
- Original source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/h-siyuan/ScreenDrag
- Kind: dataset
- Review: curated
- Scope: core
- Environments: desktop
- Topics: grounding, evaluation
- Evidence checked: 2026-10-16T11:12:56Z
- ID: url:fe43af1801032be708cc

## Limitations

Raw and Parquet folders are alternative views of the same data and should not be counted as independent samples. The inspected card did not state a license.
